takes.title: Rise from face down into a ready crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer presses the chest off the floor, comes through hands and knees, then stands into a low ready stance.

takes.title: Push up from face down and settle in a squat
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the chest and hips off the floor, plants the feet from a kneel, then rises and settles with both hands forward.

takes.title: Rise from side lying through a seated brace
takes.actionDescription: The performer rolls up from the side, plants a hand behind in sitting, then comes through a squat into a bent-knee ready position.

takes.title: Get up from side lying into a wide stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer rolls from the side into sitting, supports the body with the hands, then pushes up and opens the feet into a wide stance.

takes.title: Low motorcycle pose with arms forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a deep bent-knee stance with both arms forward at shoulder height.

takes.title: Long ready idle with weight shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps into a staggered, slightly crouched stance and alternates weight between the feet with loose arms.

takes.title: Ready idle in a staggered crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a low staggered stance, making small knee bends and arm adjustments without moving far.

takes.sourceDescription: Get Up From Ground Laying on Back
takes.title: Get up from the back into a low crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer rocks up from the back into sitting, plants the feet, and rises into a low ready position with both hands forward.

takes.sourceDescription: Get Up From Ground Laying on Back
takes.title: Get up from the back with a wide plant
takes.actionDescription: The performer rolls upward, braces on one hand behind, then pushes through a deep squat into a wide upright stance.
